QuestInfo.name: Find Memories Please
QuestInfo.0: The information is not great but get the information to Amnesiac Temple Keeper.
QuestInfo.1: You hear #bJohanna#k the priestess is selling memories. You wonder how.
QuestInfo.2: You got the Memory Restoration Potion from Johanna and gave it to Amnesiac Temple Keeper.

0.0: My name is #rKao#k? That...sounds very unfamiliar to me. And I've been here for a while? So everyone here should know me? Well, why won't anyone tell me anything then?
0.1: I feel uneasy...like I'm the only one in the world. I want to rediscover my memories. I want to know my past. Please help me find myself.

yes.0: Another keeper stopped by while you were gathering info. She told me that she was #rselling memories#k. She told me to come by whenever I needed them, so could you talk to her for me? Her name is #bJohanna#k.

no.0: I don't know when my memories will return. What should I do if no one helps me?

1.0: You think I'll get all my memories back if I drink this potion?

yes.0: (Gulp gulp)... Ah! I... I remember everything!

default.0: How exactly does one sell memories...?
